definitions.explanation: Basic mathematics taught in elementary school, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

examples.japanese: {算数|さんすう}が{苦手|にがて}な{子供|こども}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many children are weak at arithmetic.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}で{算数|さんすう}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned arithmetic in elementary school.

examples.japanese: {算数|さんすう}のテストで{満点|まんてん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got a perfect score on the arithmetic test.

notes:
SCOPE NOTE:
{算数|さんすう} specifically refers to elementary school mathematics (grades 1-6 in Japan). From middle school onward, mathematics is called {数学|すうがく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{算数|さんすう}の{授業|じゅぎょう} (arithmetic class)
・{算数|さんすう}の{問題|もんだい} (arithmetic problem)
・{算数|さんすう}ドリル (arithmetic workbook/drill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{数学|すうがく} - mathematics (middle school and beyond, more advanced)
・{計算|けいさん} - calculation (the act of computing)
